summary: Parses a pit crew animation definition file (.ANM) into a heap-allocated actor entry array: opens the file via a .RT-extension open helper, allocates fuel-rig mesh resources, performs a first pass to count ACTOR directives, allocates an array of 120-byte (30 dword) actor entries, then a second pass that interprets ACTOR / DETAIL / MESH / POSITION / MOVE / ROTATE directives per line (wheel-on/off MTS mesh names dispatch to mode-dependent subsystem calls). On success it appends collision geometry to a linked list, guards vertex-buffer resource allocation (logging a setup failure), scales a linked-list float, runs delegate/flag post-processing, sets the loaded flag on this and dispatches each actor entry. Returns -1 on early open/allocation failure, otherwise 0.

operations.description: Opens the animation file: sub_587DB0(a2, aRt) with the path parameter and the '.RT' extension string global (aRt); stores the handle locally and returns -1 if the open fails.

Reads the global collision geometry handle dword_8AFE88 into a local, then allocates fuel-rig mesh resources via MeshResourceAllocator(this+0x14, a4, aFuelrigMts, 20); returns -1 on allocation failure.
Guards on detail-level global dword_7CF884 >= 2; when set, fetches a linked-list node via LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230(0) and, if non-null, inserts a node at index 0 via LinkedListNodeInsert_5930.

First pass: repeatedly reads lines via FileReadUntilNewline(v51, 384, file); skips lines sub_5651B0(v45) marks as section headers/empty, and increments the actor count for each line whose prefix matches aActor via sub_587C20(v51, aActor).
Rewinds the file to the beginning via sub_587F64(v5, 0, 0) so the second parse pass can re-read every line.
Allocates the actor entry array with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(120 * count + 4); on success stores the count in the first dword and lets the entries follow at v9+1.
Initializes every actor entry (30 dword / 120 byte stride): zeroes entry[25], entry[27], entry[29] and calls sub_4A2220(entry) for defaults.
Stores the actor entry array pointer into this[4] (field +0x10, actorArrayPtr) and resets this[3] (field +0xC, actorCount) to 0 before the second pass.
Second pass: reads each line via FileReadUntilNewline(v51, 384, file); non-header lines (sub_5651B0(v45) false) are tested against directive prefixes with sub_587C20(v51, token).

ACTOR directive: computes the current actor entry address as this[4] + 120 * this[3]++ (incrementing actorCount), parses 'ACTOR %s' via StrlenFormatCallWrapper, strips quotes with QuoteStrippingCopy, and sets entry byte +3 to 1 when the name equals aLman or aLollipop.
DETAIL directive: parses an integer with StrlenFormatCallWrapper using 'DETAIL %d' and stores the word into the actor entry at +0.

MESH directive: parses 'MESH %s', strips quotes, and compares the mesh name against the eight wheel MTS names (lf/rf/lr/rr x wheelon/wheeloff). Wheel meshes dispatch via ModeDependentSubsystemCall(entry, onOff, wheelIndex, meshName, meshTablePtr(a3+4 for front / a3+8 for rear), this[5]); any other name is copied into the entry via StringCopyWithReverse.
POSITION directive: parses 'POSITION %f %f %f' via StrlenFormatCallWrapper and stores the three floats into the actor entry at +76, +80, +84.

MOVE directive: parses 'MOVE %s %s %f' via StrlenFormatCallWrapper, strips quotes, formats an animation filename with '%s.ANM' via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, then calls sub_4A22D0(entry, moveName, anmFileName, extraString, floatParam).

ROTATE directive: parses 'ROTATE %f' via StrlenFormatCallWrapper, reads the existing rotation triple at entry +88/+92/+96, multiplies the parsed angle by 0.01745433 (degrees to radians), and writes the triple back to +88/+92/+96.
Closes the animation file via FileCloseWithLock once parsing is complete.
Appends the collision geometry handle this[5] (field +0x14) to the actor linked list via ActorNodeLinkedListAppend.

Guards on VertexBufferResourceAllocation(dword_8AFE88); on failure calls StringRelocationCopy(0, v52), and if StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_2, 708) is true logs a setup failure via DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aUnableToSetupA).
Scales a linked-list node's float field by 4.0: fetches node 0 via LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230(0) and, if non-null, multiplies *(float*)(node+24) by 4.0 in place.
Runs post-load processing: ConditionalDelegateDispatch(dword_7C54E8, v42, v41) on the player-vehicle global, then sub_4A3320(v42, v41) with the two 12-byte buffers.
Completes the load: sets this[0] (field +0x0, loadedFlag) to 1, calls FlagFieldBitManipulation(1, 0, 0, 0) and FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall(this).
When actorCount this[3] (field +0xC) is greater than 0, iterates each 120-byte actor entry and calls ConditionalDispatch_27d0(entry); with zero actors the loop is skipped entirely.
Returns 0 on success; -1 was returned earlier on file-open or mesh-allocation failure.

clean_pseudocode: count = 0; while (ReadLine(line)) if (!IsHeader(line) && IsToken(line, aActor)) count++;
array = Alloc(120 * count + 4); if (array) { array[0] = count; for each entry: zero entry[25/27/29]; InitEntry(entry); }
if (IsToken(line, aActor)) { entry = this->actorArrayPtr + 120 * this->actorCount++; Parse('ACTOR %s'); entry->isLollipopOrMan = (name==aLman || name==aLollipop); }
if (IsToken(line, aMesh)) { Parse('MESH %s'); if (wheel MTS name) ModeDependentSubsystemCall(entry, on, idx, name, table, this->collision); else CopyMeshName(entry, name); }
if (IsToken(line, aMove)) { Parse('MOVE %s %s %f'); Format('%s.ANM'); ProcessMove(entry, move, anm, extra, f); }
if (AllocVertexBufferResources(dword_8AFE88)) { RelocateString(0, buf); if (SplitString(1, aDDevF119992002_2, 708)) LogSetupFailure(); }

Packet lists string globals aSAnm, aMoveSSF, aPositionFFF, aRotateF, aMeshS, aDetailD, aActorS and globals dword_8ACEE0, dword_8AFE64, flt_59E65C, dbl_59E7D8 as referenced, but the raw decompilation contains no direct use of them (likely xrefs via format-string globals or neighboring functions).
Semantics of ConditionalDispatch_27d0, FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall and FlagFieldBitManipulation are unknown beyond their calls from here.

Buffers v41/v42 (12 bytes each) and v45 (384 bytes) are passed to sub_5651B0 and sub_4A3320/ConditionalDelegateDispatch without visible local initialization of their contents; the loaded-flag call FlagBasedLoopConditionalCall(this) uses this rather than a local buffer.
